title: Launch HN: Vendo (YC S26) – Let users build features on top of your product
summary: Vendo is a YC S26 startup that enables users to build custom features like dashboards, workflows, and small apps directly inside the SaaS products they already use by describing their needs in natural language.
problem_solved: SaaS products struggle to accommodate diverse customer needs without accumulating technical debt from custom implementations.
why_valuable: It allows product teams to stop building one-off custom features while giving enterprise customers the customization they demand.
